en: Sappaccayadukādi, Kusalattika (The Triplet of the Wholesome)
Dependent on a conditioned wholesome state, a non-conditioned unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.
Dependent on a conditioned unwholesome state, a non-conditioned unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a conditioned indeterminate state, a non-conditioned indeterminate state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one. (Abbreviated; similar to the conditioned section.)
